_meta.what_this_is: Three logit vectors of the kind that come out of a language model's final layer, right before the softmax that turns them into next-token probabilities. 'moderate' has ordinary small logits where the textbook softmax works fine. 'large' has logits near 800 -- well above exp's overflow threshold of about 709 -- which is exactly where the naive formula breaks. 'shifted' is 'moderate' plus a large constant, to show shift-invariance.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The logit values are hand-authored so the overflow, the NaN, and the shift-invariance are exact and checkable; every exp, sum, and division is computed in softmax.py, nothing is precomputed here.
